capability_deltas: The live durable scheduler remains the primary ChatGPT-independent no-effect execution route; canary issue #1648 succeeded, received a machine receipt and closed automatically.
Capability Truth now includes cross-estate TTL/currentness, adapter availability, authority/effect/privacy fit, failure-domain exclusion and ranked provider redundancy.
FCOA provider/external routing is fail-closed on fresh qualified Capability Truth before existing credential, effect and fence authority checks run.
Provider-backed CROSS_ESTATE_CURRENTNESS and CROSS_ESTATE_ROUTE_SCORECARD projections are the live routing substrate for FCOA and Alpha-Omega.

Google Sheets/Apps Script gateway persistence is currently callable for durable queue/checkpoint writes, but the native unattended consumer remains unproven; a 2026-09-22 no-effect GAS_SELFTEST canary is still PENDING with no result receipt.

Google and Microsoft identity/calendar/mail read surfaces are independently live; Canva and Adobe form complementary creative production failure domains; OpenAI Platform exposes encrypted key bootstrap targets without returning raw key material.
route_deltas: Before FCOA chooses a provider/external executor, require a fresh qualified Capability Truth adapter; stale, source-only, connector-unavailable or authority-mismatched routes are ineligible.

Prefer independent provider redundancy where semantics match: Google/Microsoft for identity, calendar and mail telemetry; Canva/Adobe for creative production; GitHub/Google-native candidate for durable scheduling.
Use lazy currentness refresh instead of constant polling: refresh the needed capability when its TTL expires or the selected route fails.
A direct connector outage is route-scoped evidence, not capability absence; alternate adapters remain eligible if fresh and qualified.

Google GAS gateway rows may be used for durable checkpoint/queue persistence only while native execution remains unproven; do not promote the scheduler until a fresh result/heartbeat proves the consumer.
Use the Alpha-Omega/Formation 60-minute prompt for aggressive finality while preserving proof, authority and durable mission continuity.
summary: Promote durable scheduler finality, cross-estate Capability Truth currentness, and FCOA fail-closed currentness routing into the stable FUSE update fabric.
